documents.source_caveat: Historical September 2009 edition for Version 10.0 concrete household biosand filters, acquired from SSWM mirror, not directly from CAWST; no byte-identity claim with current publisher offerings. Not a guarantee of potability or chemical-contaminant removal. Original disinfection/maintenance/construction warnings retained. Physical p111 checklist contains 0.6 L/min maximum versus 0.4 L/min target; pp59 and 113 use 0.4 L/min. Discrepancy preserved, not resolved or silently harmonized.
dependencies: Source assumes suitable mold, tools, graded media, construction skill, installation, monitoring and follow-up; appendices remain in original. No materials or fabricated parts supplied.

Source physical p16 explicitly retains further disinfection and safe-storage requirements; this edition is not a complete contaminant-testing or chemical-treatment reference. External references/standards and current training are not bundled.
